name: Emberkin
description: Emberkin are descended from fire elementals. They are humanoids whose bodies are a combination of flesh and fire.

features.name: Fireproof
features.description: You are immune to damage from magical or mundane flame.

features.name: Ignition
features.description: Mark a Stress to wreathe your primary weapon in flame until the end of the scene. While ablaze, it gives off a bright light and grants a 1d6 bonus to damage rolls against targets within Melee range.
